title: Young brass bands
summary: He admires the young brass bands.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: What do you think about some of the young brass bands coming up that you've heard? The young kids in general coming up?

Well a lot of the older musicians don't like it. But I like it because at least they are playing. And if they play long enough, somebody will get in with them and show them the right way to play, and they'll learn how to read music. And I admire what they're doing.
